slot.brief: Two simple universal statements (All A are B, No B are C) with four conclusion options; 1/5 difficulty so conclusions follow directly and only one is valid.

stem:
Read the statements and conclusions carefully. Which conclusion logically follows?

**Statements:**
All poets are writers.
No writers are careless.

**Conclusions:**
I. No poet is careless.
II. All poets are careless.

verdicts.working: Poets are a subset of writers, and no writers are careless; therefore no poet is careless. Conclusion II does not follow.

working:
Since every poet is a writer and no writer is careless, no poet is careless (I follows). II contradicts this restriction.

Independent check: Poets are a subset of writers, and no writers are careless; therefore no poet is careless. Conclusion II does not follow.
solution: Every poet is a writer, and no writer is careless. Therefore, no poet is careless, so conclusion I follows; conclusion II does not.
